draftUse.basis: Validated identity/reuse and matched measurement rules

applicabilityReason: Relational 4-tuple sealed-binding routing, 8-codebook invariance, and 33753-settle execution require explicit identity and evidence accounting.

selectedRules.applicabilityReason: Shared native 112-source reuse, 2-variable 4-tuple slot routing, and sealed hcr-r37-joint-tuple-v1 consumer handoff require full source/role/revision/config binding without host truth repair.
Information-matched exact_joint control and complete accounting of source, role, 6-stage transfer envelope, upper pipeline, storage, audit, and seal costs without efficiency overclaims.

facts.statement: R37 tested 4-tuple joint vs marginal-closure correlation erasure under only 4/8 tokens per namespace ({0,1,2,3} or {4,5,6,7}), where cnot20 collapses to identity, 100% of mismatch role comparisons had Hamming distance d=1, and only 8/64 ordered code pairs and 4/16 Hamming pairs occurred. R46 tested relational codebook transfer only on n=2 Z-candidates (feasible2), and R47 tested capacity n=1..4 only on the single-variable unary AST pipeline.

In R37, membership(alternatives, relation) feeds 4x|R| pair gates into or0..4; native_marginal applies a 3-layer bipartite marginal re-cross network projection0/1 (f0..3 -> p00,p01,p10,p11 -> e0..3 -> goal) that collapses 16 joint signatures to 10 closure signatures; feasible4 seals hcr-r37-joint-tuple-v1 binding (eligibility 4 floats + coverage_activation 1 float + state_sha256); isolated consume_t evaluates T(X,Y) and feeds 9 continuous drives (e0..3, t0..3, complete) into query4.

112 lower sources (56 C + 56 T) + 809 stage-transfer settles (64 role + 16 pair + 121 or0..4 + 32 projection0/1 + 64 feasible4 + 512 query4) + 32832 upper settles (16288 native_joint + 16544 native_marginal) = 33753 native settles (+ 256 exact_joint = 768 evaluations, 12 batches x 64). 600s total / 240s stage / raw 128MiB / cache 128MiB / AS 512MiB / worker 1 / retry 0.

invariants.statement: Only token-to-code map and grounded 112-source 8-token inputs across 32 base cases (Part I 16 c_mask=0..15, Part II 8 diagonal/anti-diagonal, Part III 8 L-shaped) are supplied to unchanged R37 execute; core/learner/AST/Config/initial 0.5/guards/controller/history/Cost are unchanged. Every one of the 32 base cases must induce 8/8 distinct restricted maps (0 unchanged pairs), and each codebook must exercise all 64 ordered code pairs, all 16 ordered Hamming pairs, and all 56 cross-domain fact pairs.
invariants.scope: R48 112 sources / 32 base across Parts I-III (8/8 restricted classes, 64/64 code pairs, 16/16 Hamming pairs, 56/56 fact pairs) / 809 transfer / 33753 settles

invariants.statement: 64 actual role inputs partition into 4 exact Hamming distance classes d in {0,1,2,3}; 16 pair settles exhaust all 4^2 Hamming-pair drives for all 40320 bijections; 121 or0..4, 32 projection0/1 (collapsing 16 masks to 10 closure signatures with inner p00..p11/e0..e3 margins), 64 feasible4 (32 direct_or + 32 via_projection), and 512 query4 settles audit worst-case inner-margin [false_max, true_min] bounds without claiming 64^n enumeration. designChoices.statement: Construct 32 base cases (16 Part I c_mask=0..15 complete lattice + 8 Part II diagonal/anti-diagonal counterexamples + 8 Part III L-shaped counterexamples) with 32 distinguishing 4-token cohorts across 112 grounded sources and 809 separate stage-transfer settles (64 role + 16 pair + 121 or0..4 + 32 projection0/1 + 64 feasible4 + 512 query4).
designChoices.rationale: Guarantees 8/8 restricted maps per base, 64/64 ordered code pairs, 16/16 ordered Hamming pairs, and 56/56 cross-domain fact pairs per codebook, 16/16 joint vs 10/16 marginal-closure signatures, and 128 correlation-loss abstentions with 0 false assertions within 33753 settles.

verificationObligations.failureOracle: nonbijection/unknown token accepted; restricted map classes < 8; ordered code pairs < 64; ordered Hamming pairs < 16; cross-domain fact pairs < 56; source/role/config drift; hidden oracle consumer
